description:
Activate Karn twice by paying {2}, causing Halo Fountain and Khalni Gem to become a creature.
Activate Khalni Gem by tapping it, adding {W}{W}.
Activate Halo Fountain's second ability by paying {W}{W}, tapping it, and then untapping it and Khalni Gem, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat from step 2.
